fields.label: OCR Provider Mode
fields.description: Locked to Google Vision API for this deployment. The Mock path still exists in integrations/ocr.py (kept as an offline fallback/reference) but is no longer selectable here. The earlier Azure Document Intelligence adapter has been removed entirely — it was built against the old one-record-per-day shape and doesn't fit the current Daily Log child-table model.

fields.label: Google Service Account Key (JSON)
fields.description: Paste the FULL contents of the service account key JSON file here (from Google Cloud Console -> IAM & Admin -> Service Accounts -> Keys). Stored encrypted in this site's database, never in source control. The service account needs the "Cloud Vision AI User" role (or broader, e.g. Editor) on the project, and the Cloud Vision API must be enabled for that project. This is the only field needed for OCR — Vision API has no per-project processor to configure, unlike Document AI.

fields.label: OCR Daily Row Pattern (regex)
fields.description: ONE regular expression (not JSON), with named groups, tried against every line of Google Vision's raw recognized text to pull out one Daily Log row per matching line — named groups: day_label, date, from_time, to_time, total_hours, normal_shift_hours, overtime_hours, breakdown_hours, work_description (all optional; a line missing a group just leaves that value blank/0). This is the main thing to tune once you have a real filled-in log sheet and know what Vision actually recognizes off it — no code change/deploy needed. Leave this blank to use the built-in default in integrations/ocr.py. To see what Vision actually recognized on a real run (so you know what the pattern needs to match), check the "OCR Completed" entry in that log sheet's own audit trail — it includes the raw text. Cloud Vision's plain text detection has no real notion of table structure, so this line-based approach is a starting point, not a guarantee — treat every extracted row as needing a human check in AI Review until this has been verified against real output.

fields.label: OCR Field Label Patterns (JSON)
fields.description: Secondary tool, for matching an optional whole-sheet total that's printed as a single labelled value rather than inside the day-by-day table, as {"field_name": ["regex pattern", ...]}. Most tuning work happens on OCR Daily Row Pattern above, not this. Leave a field out (or leave this whole box blank) to fall back to the built-in default patterns in integrations/ocr.py.
